services.desc: Our Ocean Skills Series Includes Three Workshops Fully booked? Send us an email l to get on the waitlist! 3 Hours per session, 10am-1pm About This winter we are offering our Ocean Skills Workshops as a 3-part in-person series of workshops! (In recent years it has been offered online). Each session meets for three hours. We recommend taking all three workshops together, but it is okay to only take one or two if you have scheduling restrictions or are most interested in learning the topic in a certain workshop. Students will receive access to a course website with exercises and In-Person Course • 3 Hours Per Session • MITA members get $10 off per session

services.name: Sea Kayak Guide Training
services.desc: Start the Journey of Becoming a Maine Sea Kayak Guide! Fully booked? Email us a call to get on the waitlist! Four 8-hour sessions on consecutive weekends About This intensive course is designed to prepare students for the state testing process involved in becoming a licensed Maine Sea Kayak Guide. Although our course is focused on the goal of passing the state guide exam, we also intend for students to develop skills and knowledge that will make them better paddlers and more competent outdoor leaders. The course is designed to be enjoyable and educational for anyone with significant Ages 16+ • Four Days

services.name: Casco Bay Full Day Tour
services.desc: Encounter the History and Beauty of Casco Bay by Kayak Fully booked? Give us a call to get on the waitlist! 6 Hours About Our Full-Day Kayak Tour is a chance to sea kayak to some of the most historically fascinating and scenic landmarks in the Portland region. Unlike our other tours, we limit this trip to 6 or fewer people and we require participants to have at least one previous sea kayaking experience. You'll spend the day island-hopping through the rugged islands of Casco Bay. Along the way you'll visit several 19th century forts, paddle past lighthouses and feel the swell of the Ages 16+ • 6 Hours

services.name: Family Sea Kayaking Tour
services.desc: A kid-friendly sea kayaking tour on Casco Bay with an expert guide Ages 7+ • Ages 7-12 Must Ride with an Adult • 2 Hours

services.name: Yoga at the Fort
services.desc: This trip combines two of our favorite activities: sea kayaking and yoga! Paddle out to Fort Gorges for a 45-minute yoga session taught by Ashley Flowers or Cayce Lannon. Fully booked? Give us a call to get on the waitlist! 3 Hours and 15 Minutes About Fort Gorges, a Civil War-era granite fort surrounded by water, is one of the most fascinating spots in Casco Bay, and it's only accessible by small boat. The former parade grounds, surrounded by gorgeous granite walls, is a remarkably ideal spot for yoga. The trip will begin with your licensed kayak guide offering a basic kayak lesson Ages 16+ • 3 Hours and 15 Minutes

services.name: SUP Yoga
services.desc: Come try stand up paddle board yoga! 1.5 hours About Come try stand up paddle board yoga! Lessons taught on paddle boards combine a great work out, with an amazing view. Try an evening session on Tuesday or Thursday or check out one of our early morning Sunrise SUP Yoga classes. To reserve a six-class session select the date on the calendar that your preferred session begins. Your booking will reserve you a spot in each of the six classes in that session. If we need to cancel due to weather the session will be extended. Please inform us in advance if you don't plan on showing up for 1.5 Hours

services.name: Portland Harbor SUP Tour
services.desc: Come Enjoy the Sunset Fully booked? Give us a call to get on the waitlist! 1.5 Hours About This tour takes a route along the scenic waterfront of Portland harbor, giving you views of rugged islands, beautiful lighthouses and historic forts. We often spot seals and we always view a variety of marine birds. .Your tour will start off with a quick SUP lesson. Then your licensed Maine Guide will lead you on a leisurely paddle along the Portland waterfront, pointing out interesting sights along the way, including lighthouses, lobsterboats and 19th-century forts. This is a great trip for Ages 14+ • 1.5 Hours

services.name: SUP Sunset Tour
services.desc: A guided stand-up paddle (SUP) tour on Casco Bay Ages 14+ • 1.5 Hours

services.name: Intro to Sea Kayaking, Part 1
services.desc: Great if you are new to Sea Kayaking! Fully booked? Give us a call to get on the waitlist! 3 Hours About This is the course to take if you are new to sea kayaking — or if you started sea kayaking without gaining a solid foundation of skills and knowledge. You'll learn all the basics with a small group of other paddlers in the protected waters near our East End Beach site in Portland. Your instructor will get your group started onshore with a discussion of equipment and the risks and hazards kayakers face on the Maine coast. Then you'll get fitted into kayaks and head onto Casco Bay Ages 15+ • 3 Hours

services.name: Intro to Sea Kayaking, Part 2
services.desc: Great if you are new to Sea Kayaking! Fully booked? Give us a call to get on the waitlist! 3 Hours About This course builds on the skills taught in Intro to Sea Kayaking Part I and teaches you about crucial resources and equipment that sea kayakers rely on while paddling the Maine coast. This course is only open to students who have completed the Part I course OR have taken a introductory kayaking lesson elsewhere. A major goal of this session will be to improve your overall control of your boat and efficiency of your strokes so that you’re better prepared when you encounter Ages 15+ • 3 Hours
